data.raw_text:
The theory that American assistance of any sort would create a “rally around the Khomeinist flag” response is nonsense.

The late Michael Ledeen, a consultant to the National Security Council, DoS, and DoD before he became a scholar at FDD for many years, wrote in his 2007 book, “The Iranian Time Bomb”:

“Revolutions rarely succeed without external support. Neither George Washington nor the Ayatollah Khomeini would have won without foreign help, nor would Lech Walesa in Poland, Corazon Aquino in the Philippines, or Vaclav Havel in Czechoslovakia. Almost all contemporary revolutionary movements get help from someone outside.”

Recall that in 2009 the anti-Islamists chanted: "Obama, are you with us or against us?"

Obama was not with them. He was attempting to cozy up to their oppressors. Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei was not interested.
